newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebecor Printing signs Tele-Direct deal.
newsitem.headline: Quebecor Printing signs Tele-Direct deal.

text.p: Quebecor Printing Inc said on Tuesday that it signed a long-term contract with BCE Inc unit Tele-Direct (Publications) Inc valued at more than C$400 million.
The contract is a renewal agreement that comes into effect on January 1, 1997, and extends to 2002, with a subsequent option that extends the contract to 2007.
The contract covers the printing and binding of about 90 percent of Tele-Direct's White and Yellow Page telephone directories for eastern Canada.
Quebecor Printing said directory is an important growth market for the company in North America and it plans to expand its U.S. capacity by about 40 percent in 1997.
